Game Overview

At its heart, Tasty Blue is a fishing game about embark on an oceanic feast as a ravenous goldfish with an insatiable appetite. Devour everything in sight, growing ever larger, while skillfully evading and eventually consuming any adversaries blocking your path. How big can you become in this underwater adventure?
